segments.scene_heading: 1-1 Day | Int. The Quinn family mansion, living room
segments.time: Day, bright daylight through the arched French windows, warm chandelier fill
segments.first_state: Axis: the line from the single cream armchair to the long cream sofa. The camera stays on the front (bookshelf) wall side and looks toward the three tall arched French windows on the back wall; reverse singles on Natalie look toward the bookshelf wall. The one long cream sofa runs across the frame in front of the windows and faces the camera. The white marble fireplace is on the left wall at frame left. The open white double doorway is on the right wall at frame right. The one single cream armchair stands in the foreground centre with its back to the camera, facing the sofa across the one low glass-and-gold coffee table. Natalie sits upright in the armchair, three-quarter back to the camera, facing the sofa, hands in her lap. George sits at the fireplace end of the sofa, frame left, facing the camera and Natalie. Lauren sits at the doorway end of the sofa, frame right, at the same depth as George, legs crossed, facing Natalie. The one hospital statement lies flat on the coffee table. Cassie is not yet in the room; she waits out of sight in the marble entrance hall beyond the double doorway.

shots.camera: Wide shot, slow push in from the bookshelf wall toward the sofa, eye-level, symmetrical composition
shots.visual: The cream-and-gold living room in daylight. Natalie sits in the armchair in the foreground centre with her back to the camera. George sits at frame left and Lauren at frame right on the cream sofa in front of the arched windows, with the glass coffee table between them and Natalie.
shots.audio: <Faint ticking of a clock, distant birdsong outside the windows>

shots.camera: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, high angle onto the coffee table
shots.visual: The hospital statement lies on the glass coffee table, its bold total at the bottom.

shots.camera: Medium shot, reverse over-the-shoulder shot from behind Lauren's shoulder at the doorway end of the sofa, looking toward the bookshelf wall, eye-level
shots.visual: Lauren's shoulder and hair fill the foreground edge. Natalie in the armchair leans slightly forward toward her father, hands clasped, eyes hopeful.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, timid and hopeful): {Hey, Dad can I borrow $50,000?}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Only Natalie, framed tight on her face and shoulders; her eyes glisten as she pleads.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, pleading): {Mom needs kidney dialysis and we really don't have any money.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front, eye-level
shots.visual: George at the fireplace end of the sofa, frame left, rubs his hands together and glances right at Lauren beside him at frame right.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, hesitant, trailing off): {Natalie, the thing is}

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge, slight low angle
shots.visual: Lauren uncrosses her legs and fixes Natalie, toward the camera, with a cold stare, lip curled.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, icy and contemptuous): {How shameless of you to come here and beg us for money?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld, reverse single on Natalie in the armchair, looking toward the bookshelf wall
shots.visual: Natalie presses a hand to her chest and nods quickly toward the sofa.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, earnest): {I'll pay you guys back, I promise.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front, slow push in on George at frame left
shots.visual: George turns right toward Lauren and lifts an open palm, gently placating.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, mild and placating): {Lauren, maybe we can let her borrow the money.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall, locked-off camera
shots.visual: Only Natalie in the armchair; she looks up toward her father on the sofa, off screen, lips parting with a small flicker of hope.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, softly): {I mean, it's her mother that's sick.}

shots.camera: Close-up from the front, clean single on Lauren, eye-level
shots.visual: Only Lauren, framed tight on her face; her arched brows narrow as she turns her head sharply left toward George.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, suspicious and sharp): {You're still thinking about your ex-wife?}

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on George with Lauren's shoulder at the frame-right edge
shots.visual: George shakes his head quickly and raises both hands.
shots.audio: Dialogue (George, in English, flustered): {No, no.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front, slightly above
shots.visual: Lauren at frame right leans left over George and taps a finger against his chest; George at frame left shrinks back into the sofa.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, cold and controlling): {Do I need to remind you this is your family now?}

shots.camera: Close-up from the front, clean single on George, locked-off camera
shots.visual: Only George, framed tight on his face and hands; he lowers his eyes and turns his wedding band with his thumb.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, icy, low): {George, without me you'd have nothing.}

segments.light_audio: Daylight floods in from the three arched French windows on the back wall behind the sofa, warm fill from the crystal chandelier. Live sound: quiet room tone, a faint clock tick, distant birdsong.

segments.time: Day, bright daylight through the arched French windows, warm chandelier fill
segments.first_state: Axis: the line from the single cream armchair to the long cream sofa. shots.camera: Wide shot, locked-off camera from the bookshelf wall, eye-level
shots.visual: Cassie appears in the open double doorway at frame right with a mocking pout. Natalie in the foreground armchair, and George and Lauren on the sofa, all turn their heads right toward her.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sing-song and mocking): {Aww.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, tracking Cassie from the doorway at frame right leftward to the armchair
shots.visual: Cassie strolls across the rug from the doorway and stops beside the armchair on its doorway side, frame right of Natalie, standing over the seated Natalie.
shots.audio: <Stiletto heels click on the wood floor, gold bangles jingle>

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle on Cassie, dirty single with the top of Natalie's head at the frame-left edge
shots.visual: Cassie looks down at Natalie with a smirk, one hand on her hip.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sneering): {If it isn’t my loser sister asking for money like a beggar? How pathetic?}

shots.camera: Close-up, high angle, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall
shots.visual: Only Natalie, framed tight on her face; she lowers her eyes, her jaw tightening.

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie picks up the hospital statement from the coffee table and rises from the armchair; Cassie, at the armchair's frame-right side, steps back half a pace toward the doorway.
shots.audio: <Paper rustles>

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld, following Natalie rightward toward the double doorway at frame right
shots.visual: Natalie walks past Cassie toward the double doorway, the statement in her hand, and stops a few steps short of the doorway.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, quiet and hurt): {This is a mistake.}

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Cassie with Natalie's shoulder at the frame-right edge
shots.visual: Cassie spins right toward Natalie and raises one hand with a sly smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sly): {Wait, we'll give you the money.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single on Natalie near the doorway
shots.visual: Only Natalie, framed on her face and shoulders; she stops and half-turns back toward the room, the statement pressed to her side.

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front
shots.visual: Lauren at frame right sits up straight on the sofa and stares at Cassie; George at frame left looks up beside her.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, startled): {What?}

shots.camera: Close-up, slight low angle, clean single on Cassie
shots.visual: Only Cassie, framed tight on her face; she tilts her head right toward Natalie with a cruel little smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sweet and smug): {If you marry Sebastian Klein in my place.}

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge, slow push in
shots.visual: Lauren breaks into a delighted smile and points proudly toward Cassie.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, delighted): {My daughter is so smart. That's a good idea.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Cassie's shoulder, from the front
shots.visual: Natalie, wide-eyed and gripping the statement, steps back from the doorway past Cassie and ends beside the armchair on its frame-right side, with Cassie now next to her, nearer the doorway.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, shocked): {Sebastian Klein? The illegitimate son of the Klein family?}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall, handheld
shots.visual: Only Natalie, framed on her face and shoulders; she shakes her head slightly in disbelief.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, incredulous): {Isn't he in jail right now?}

segments.light_audio: Daylight from the three arched French windows on the back wall behind the sofa, warm chandelier fill. Live sound: Cassie's stiletto heels on the wood floor, her bangles jingling, paper rustling, quiet room tone.

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Cassie with Natalie's shoulder at the frame-left edge
shots.visual: Cassie folds her arms and nods.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, breezy): {Yup.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, low angle, clean single on Cassie, slow push in
shots.visual: Only Cassie, framed on her face and shoulders; she wrinkles her nose in disgust and flicks her hair over her shoulder.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, contemptuous): {He's a dirt bag and a good for nothing loser.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, reverse clean single on Natalie looking toward the bookshelf wall, locked-off camera
shots.visual: Only Natalie; her fingers tighten on the hospital statement as she stares at Cassie, who is off screen beside her toward the doorway.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, smug): {That's why I can't marry him.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front
shots.visual: Lauren at frame right nods firmly beside George at frame left.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, crisp): {That's right.}

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, slight high angle, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge
shots.visual: Lauren turns left to George and pats his knee.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, sweetly cold): {Natalie is also your daughter.}

shots.camera: Close-up from the front, clean single on Lauren
shots.visual: Only Lauren, framed tight on her face; she looks back toward Natalie with a thin mauve-lipped smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, drawling, mocking): {She can be the one who marries Sebastard De-Klein.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Cassie's shoulder, from the front
shots.visual: Natalie shakes her head and takes a step back against the frame-right side of the armchair.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, firm): {No, I'm not going to.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, low angle, dirty single on Cassie with Natalie's arm at the frame-left edge
shots.visual: Cassie leans left toward Natalie and taps the hospital statement in Natalie's hand with one fingernail.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, taunting): {Do you want us to pay for your mother's medical bills or not?}

shots.camera: Medium close-up from the front, clean single on George
shots.visual: Only George, framed on his face and shoulders; he looks down at his hands and stays silent.

shots.camera: Medium shot from the front, dirty single on Lauren with George's shoulder at the frame-left edge
shots.visual: Lauren crosses her legs and raises her eyebrows at Natalie, waiting.

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld, reverse single on Natalie standing by the armchair, looking toward the bookshelf wall
shots.visual: Natalie closes her eyes and her hand crumples the edge of the hospital statement.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, quiet, defeated): {Fine.}

shots.camera: Close-up, reverse clean single, slow push in on Natalie's face
shots.visual: Only Natalie, framed tight on her face; she opens her eyes and lifts her chin, her gaze steady.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, steely): {I'll marry Sebastian Klein.}

shots.camera: Close-up, low angle, clean single on Cassie
shots.visual: Only Cassie, framed tight on her face; she smirks and twirls a gold hoop earring.

shots.camera: Medium shot, two-shot of the sofa from the front, slow pull out
shots.visual: Lauren at frame right smiles in satisfaction on the sofa while George at frame left keeps his eyes lowered beside her.
